resources.string: Speed up an older TV: we will disable unnecessary preinstalled apps. Nothing is deleted, and everything can be restored with a single tap.
Follow these steps on your TV with your remote:
Click \"Build number\" 7 times until Developer options are unlocked
Enable \"USB debugging\" and \"Network debugging / Wi-Fi debugging\"
Check your TV\'s IP address in Network settings
On some TV models, \"Build number\" is inside \"System\" or \"Android TV OS build\".
Settings → Device Preferences → About → Click \"Build\" 7 times → Back → Developer Options → USB/Network Debugging
Settings → Device Preferences → About → Click \"Build\" 7 times → Back → Additional Settings → Developer Options → USB Debugging
Settings → System → About → Click \"Android TV OS build\" 7 times → Back → System → Developer Options → Debugging
Settings → Device Preferences → About → Click \"Build\" 7 times → Back → Developer Options → USB Debugging
All Settings → Android Settings → Device Preferences → About → Click \"Build\" 7 times → Back → Developer Options
Settings → System → About → Click \"Android TV OS build\" 7 times → Back → System → Developer Options → Network Debugging

YAiPlayer switches off apps on your TV over network debugging (ADB). Nothing is deleted and everything can be switched back, but a TV firmware may behave unexpectedly. The manufacturer may refuse warranty service for problems caused by these changes. You act at your own risk.
On the first connection the TV asks «Allow debugging?». Tick «Always allow from this computer» and press OK.
Only addresses in your home network are allowed.
The TV does not answer. Check the IP address, that network debugging is on and that the phone is on the same Wi-Fi.
The TV did not allow debugging. Press «Connect» again and confirm «Allow» on the TV screen.
Only apps that most lists of this brand switch off.
Only apps that many lists of different brands switch off. The most careful choice.
Choose the model from the list
Switched off by %1$d lists, kept on by %2$d.
Home screen, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and remote, keyboard, TV inputs, Play Store, Google services and the setup wizard stay on.
Restart the TV and check that everything you use works. Anything can be switched back in «Manage and restore».
YAiPlayer has not changed anything on this TV yet.
Save a copy (script for a computer)
Everything is in place, nothing came back.
Found by package name and by how the community lists file each app. This is a hint, not proof.
Recognition of what is on screen (ACR)
Nothing that looks like tracking was found.
Turn off debugging on the TV
Debugging is off. To connect again, turn it on on the TV.
For TV boxes where «Whole TV box» in the remote cannot find the Google remote service.

Installs a light Home screen without ads (the open-source launcher from cleanyourtv) on the TV. Before switching, the TV starts a safety timer: if you do not confirm on the phone, the TV puts its own Home screen back by itself.
Did the new Home screen open on the TV, and does the remote work on it?
Without confirmation the TV restores its own Home screen in %1$d s.
No, bring the old one back
The new Home screen is on. The old launcher can now be ticked in the list.
It did not work. The TV kept its own Home screen.
The old Home screen is back.
Bring back the TV\'s Home screen and remove the new one
This build has no launcher for the TV.
